headline: DET @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 3.37 at NYM 4.61, with a projected total of 7.97. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Carson Benge, Francisco Alvarez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyrone Taylor because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
